meta.title: Step Contract v2 — Route + Guards + ViewBinding + Transitions (SRP split)

rationale.why: The v1 Step aggregate violated SRP by mixing routing, authorization, rendering and navigation concerns into a single object. v2 splits it into 4 independent concepts that compose. Each concept is testable in isolation; changing one does not impact the others.

routing-implementation.note: StepRouter uses a Trie for O(log N) path matching, NOT O(N) linear scan.
routing-implementation.data-structure: Compressed Radix Trie built at registration time from all step routes.
routing-implementation.performance: 500 steps → ~7 trie hops vs 500 linear comparisons.

gates.gate: Every Step is defined via defineStep (no plain object literals).
Route paths are unique across all registered steps.
Guards return GuardResult (never throw to skip).
Transitions target stepIds that exist OR external URLs.
Step has *.step.test.tsx covering route match + guards.
